events.name: MortgageEnquiryStarted
events.trigger: Customer submits mortgage enquiry (PH-009). SVC-002 creates ENT-012 MortgageApplication with status = 'enquiry' and publishes this event. Affordability pre-check is run before publication.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-014) for KYC status check. Crosses CAP-001 → CAP-005 boundary — must be async.

payload_schema.property_postcode: string — UK postcode (partial — not full address, PII minimisation)
payload_schema.ltv_ratio: number — indicative LTV at enquiry stage (percentage)

consumers.action: Checks if customer_id has a current valid KYC record. If existing customer with active KYC: publishes KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) reusing existing assessment. If new customer or expired KYC: initiates KYC workflow.
Creates immutable audit log entry for the mortgage enquiry initiation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id (PII). MCOB record-keeping: mortgage enquiry is the start of the application audit trail. Retained for 7 years.

events.name: DIPIssued
events.trigger: Automated DIP processing completes: soft credit check passes (EVT-023 received), affordability assessment passes. SVC-002 transitions MortgageApplication.status to 'dip_issued', sets dip_date and dip_expiry, and publishes this event.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and primarily consumed within CAP-001 (SVC-002 and SVC-017). Also consumed by SVC-053 for notification dispatch.

payload_schema.dip_date: string (ISO 8601 date) — date DIP was issued
payload_schema.dip_expiry: string (ISO 8601 date) — DIP expiry date (dip_date + 90 days)
payload_schema.indicative_loan_amount: number — loan amount DIP is valid for

consumers.action: Dispatches DIP certificate email and ESIS document to customer. Includes 90-day validity window and next steps for full application.
Records DIP issuance in the WORM audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id and financial terms. MCOB record-keeping obligation. 7-year retention.

events.name: CreditCheckRequested
events.trigger: SVC-002 requires a credit check from the Risk Engine (SVC-012). Published at two points: (1) DIP stage — soft credit check (no bureau footprint). (2) Full application stage — hard credit check (bureau footprint recorded). check_type field distinguishes the two.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed by CAP-004 (SVC-012) for credit scoring and CAP-005 (SVC-014) for AML check trigger on full application. Crosses two capability boundaries — must be async.

payload_schema.customer_date_of_birth: string (ISO 8601 date) — for bureau identity matching
payload_schema.customer_postcode: string — for bureau address matching (partial address only)

consumers.action: Receives credit check request. Calls credit bureau (Experian/Equifax/TransUnion) with customer identity data. Performs soft or hard check per check_type. Publishes CreditCheckCompleted (EVT-023).
On check_reason = full_application: initiates AML source-of-funds check for the property purchase amount. Parallel to the credit check.
Records credit check request in audit trail. Required for MCOB record-keeping.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.mortgage-risk.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer PII (name, DOB, postcode) and financial data. Required for MCOB audit trail. Hard credit check events are particularly sensitive — bureau footprint evidence.

events.name: CreditCheckCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-012 has received the credit bureau response and processed the credit check. Published in response to EVT-022. Contains credit score, outcome, and report reference. Consumed by SVC-002 to progress the mortgage application.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-012). Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Crosses CAP-004 → CAP-001 boundary — async event response to EVT-022.

payload_schema.application_id: string (UUID v4) — correlates to EVT-022 application_id
payload_schema.check_type: string enum (soft | hard) — matches the request
payload_schema.credit_score: number — numeric credit score (bureau-agnostic normalised score 0–1000)
payload_schema.report_reference: string — credit bureau report reference ID (for record-keeping, not full report content)
payload_schema.adverse_indicators: array<string> — flag names only (e.g. 'CCJ_within_6_years', 'IVA', 'missed_payments_12m'). No raw bureau data.

consumers.action: On DIP (soft check): if outcome = pass, completes affordability assessment and issues DIP (EVT-021). If outcome = fail/refer: declines DIP or routes to manual review. On full application (hard check): stores credit result for underwriter review. Updates MortgageApplication status.
Records credit check result in WORM audit trail. Bureau reference stored for 7 years per MCOB.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.mortgage-risk.
events.worm_rationale: Contains credit decision data and financial risk indicators. MCOB record-keeping: lending decisions must be evidenced for 7 years. Adverse indicators are sensitive personal data.

events.name: ValuationInstructed
events.trigger: SVC-002 instructs a property valuation in PH-012. ENT-014 PropertyValuation is created with status = 'instructed'. Event published after the surveyor panel instruction is sent.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed within CAP-001 for audit purposes. Valuation instruction is an external call (not event-based).

payload_schema.property_postcode: string — UK postcode of subject property
payload_schema.surveyor_id: string — appointed surveyor or 'AVM' for desktop

consumers.action: Sends customer notification: 'Valuation has been instructed for your property. Expected completion: [SLA by type]'.
Records valuation instruction in audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application ordering via application_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: MCOB record-keeping: valuation instruction is part of the lending decision audit trail.

events.name: ValuationCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-002 receives the valuation report from the external surveyor (or AVM result). ENT-014 is updated with valuation_amount, valuation_date, and status = 'completed'. LTV is recalculated on ENT-012. down_valuation_flag is set if valuation_amount < purchase_price.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed within CAP-001 for application progression and notification. down_valuation_flag = true triggers EX-001 exception path.

payload_schema.valuation_amount: number — surveyor's assessed market value in GBP
payload_schema.recalculated_ltv: number — new LTV using min(purchase_price, valuation_amount) as denominator

consumers.action: If down_valuation_flag = false: sends 'Valuation received — application proceeding to underwriting'. If down_valuation_flag = true: sends down-valuation notification with three options (EX-001 path).
Records valuation completion with amount and down-valuation flag.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application ordering via application_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: Valuation amount is a key financial decision input. MCOB requires evidence of property valuation for all mortgage lending decisions.

events.name: MortgageUnderwritingCompleted
events.trigger: PER-055 (Mortgage Underwriter) submits their underwriting decision in the workflow system. SVC-002 records the decision on ENT-012 and publishes this event. Decision values: approved | referred | declined.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed within CAP-001 for offer generation (approved) or notification (referred/declined). Regulatory significance: MCOB requires evidence of underwriting decision.

payload_schema.underwriter_id: string — staff ID of PER-055 (or PER-051 for complex cases)
payload_schema.approved_loan_amount: number (only present if decision = approved) — final approved loan amount
payload_schema.decline_reason_code: string (only present if decision = declined) — internal reason code

consumers.action: Internal: if approved → trigger offer generation. If referred → notify customer of conditions. If declined → notify customer with FOS signpost.
Dispatches underwriting decision notification to customer.
Records underwriting decision with full decision metadata in WORM audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application ordering via application_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: Underwriting decision is the core MCOB-regulated lending decision. Must be retained for 7 years with full rationale. FCA can request lending decision evidence on supervisory visit.

events.name: MortgageOfferIssued
events.trigger: SVC-002 creates ENT-015 MortgageOffer following an approved underwriting decision. The offer document is generated. MortgageApplication.status transitions to 'offer_issued'. Event published when the offer is ready for customer receipt.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed within CAP-001 and by SVC-053 for dispatch. Offer document dispatch to customer and solicitor is a regulatory obligation (MCOB 6.4).

payload_schema.offered_amount: number — approved loan amount in GBP
payload_schema.offered_rate: number — initial interest rate as annual percentage
payload_schema.apr: number — Annual Percentage Rate (MCOB 10 prescribed calculation)

consumers.action: Dispatches mortgage offer document to customer (email + post — MCOB 6.4 requires durable medium). Also dispatches copy to solicitor/conveyancer. Schedules reminder if not accepted within 5 days of reflection period end.
Records offer issuance with full terms in WORM audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application ordering via application_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: Mortgage offer is a legally binding document. MCOB requires evidence of offer terms issued to customer. 7-year retention.

events.name: MortgageOfferAccepted
events.trigger: Customer formally accepts the mortgage offer via the portal or branch. SVC-002 validates the 7-day reflection period has elapsed (MCOB 6.7). ENT-015 updated (customer_accepted: true, accepted_date). MortgageApplication.status transitions to 'offer_accepted'.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed within CAP-001 to trigger completion processing queue. Signals the application is ready for completion.

payload_schema.days_after_issue: number — accepted_date - offer_date in calendar days (must be >= 7)

consumers.action: Internal: transitions application to completion queue. Awaits solicitor requisition for funds.
Sends offer acceptance confirmation to customer and solicitor.
Records offer acceptance with acceptance date. Evidence that 7-day reflection period was honoured.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application ordering via application_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: Offer acceptance is the binding customer commitment. MCOB requires evidence of reflection period compliance (accepted_date >= offer_date + 7 days).

events.name: MortgageCompleted
events.trigger: CHAPS funds are confirmed as released to the solicitor on completion day. SVC-002 transitions MortgageApplication.status to 'completed'. Published before ENT-016 MortgageAccount is created.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for customer product holdings update and by SVC-053 for notification. Also consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-014) for AML post-completion monitoring trigger.

payload_schema.loan_amount_released: number — GBP amount released via CHAPS

consumers.action: Updates Customer product holdings to reflect completed mortgage. Updates Single Customer View.
Records property completion for AML transaction monitoring. Large CHAPS outflow on completion day is expected and recorded to prevent false-positive AML alerts in post-completion monitoring.
Records mortgage completion with CHAPS reference in WORM audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: Mortgage completion is a major financial transaction. CHAPS reference links to irrevocable payment. POCA 2002 / MLR 2017: large property transactions must be documented in audit trail.

events.name: MortgageAccountOpened
events.trigger: SVC-002 successfully creates ENT-016 MortgageAccount following CHAPS settlement confirmation. Direct debit mandate is established. Account status = 'active'. Published as the final event in the JRN-006 happy path.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-002). Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for Single Customer View update and by SVC-053 for welcome pack dispatch.

payload_schema.outstanding_balance: number — initial outstanding balance (= loan amount released) in GBP
payload_schema.rate: number — initial interest rate as annual percentage

consumers.action: Updates Customer (ENT-001) product holdings to include new mortgage account. Updates Single Customer View for FSCS reporting purposes.

Dispatches mortgage welcome pack to customer: account details, monthly payment amount and schedule, first payment date, direct debit confirmation, FSCS information (mortgage is not FSCS-protected — liability not deposit).
Records mortgage account opening in WORM audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.mortgages.
events.worm_rationale: Mortgage account opening is a regulated lending product creation event. MCOB requires evidence of account terms at opening. 7-year retention.
